g.text: 05 / A PRACTITIONER LEARNING LAB
Learn through one bounded end-to-end experiment
Choose a work product a reviewer understands, then build the smallest complete path.
1 / Frame
Research brief, analytical result or preparation draft.
Clear user, acceptance and approved/synthetic inputs.
2 / Baseline
Record current quality, time, cost and human effort.
Do this before committing to a preferred model.
3 / Experiment
Change one skill, memory rule or model with snapshots
and assessment held fixed. Keep tuning separate.
Include ordinary, ambiguous and consequential failures.
4 / Explain
Share a reproducible case, uncertainty and the next decision.
A deterministic solution, inadequate data or stopping can
be a valid result. State what would change your mind.
The deliverable: evidence
Task and baseline
Deliberate change
Observed failures
Quality + effort + cost
Limits and uncertainty
Continue / revise / retire
Proposed learning exercise informed by Ramp, Arize and Contour. A small experiment is neither production approval nor sufficient statistical validation.
